title: OBS-LC-CAL-001 row lineage and feasibility interface is frozen without candidate scoring
question: Can the frozen OBS-LC-CAL-001 source and its pre-registered isotropic-photon Table S3 rows be admitted as a reproducible candidate-neutral feasibility interface without manufacturing a likelihood, selecting a candidate, or changing the existing forward/inverse methods?
method: Load the versioned source packet, row allowlist and inverse-lane contract without importing a primary result artifact.
Verify the three authority file hashes, source edition/hash declaration, anchor/frame/table/sector metadata and the complete S3 row set for operator dimensions d=3 through d=9.
Verify that every row retains its source locator and absolute-value feasibility-bound form, while likelihood, covariance, aggregate score and candidate map remain explicitly unadmitted.
Run the non-importing independent reconstruction and compare row count, dimensions, source hash and firewall fields.

Run eight hostile mutations covering source drift, row omission/alias, table substitution, likelihood/covariance injection, map admission and candidate selection; then run the existing inverse-contract self-test.
finding: The source packet and row allowlist satisfy the hash-pinned lineage and scope contract. The complete seven-row d=3..9 slice passes the primary 60/60, independent 25/25, hostile 8/8 and integrated 15/15 checks; the inverse-lane self-test also passes. No candidate score or microscopic forward map is admitted.
decision_reason: This is an additive T0 input-interface advance for T-061. It converts the earlier source freeze into a machine-checked, pre-registered row boundary while preserving the existing T-054 forward method, T-059 inverse contract, holdout policy and all physical non-claims. It does not treat feasibility rows as a joint observation or as evidence for a microscopic candidate.
decision_scope: Finite source-lineage and row-schema validation for the OBS-LC-CAL-001 S3 isotropic-photon d=3..9 slice; no coefficient prediction, likelihood, covariance, candidate fitting, regulator limit or physical identification.
assumptions: The source packet's recorded SHA-256 identifies the exact retrieved source bytes; the PDF is not duplicated in this repository.
The S3 rows are conservative two-sigma, one-coefficient-at-a-time sensitivities and are evaluated separately.
The allowlist is fixed before any candidate comparison and remains in the source Sun-centered frame and unit convention.
The existing inverse-lane contract remains authoritative for four map stages, holdouts, candidate admission and no automatic layer promotion.
missing_assumptions: Measurement-level likelihoods and covariance for any aggregate score.
A complete source-owned candidate map through F_reg, F_lim, F_eff and F_obs, with regulator and theory-error budget.
Source-owned production dynamics, physical projection and dynamic estimand.
An independent prospective holdout and immutable acceptance rule.

adversarial_review.check: All authority paths are hash-pinned; a changed source packet or allowlist would fail the pointer check and require a new version.
Both packets retain NOT_ADMITTED likelihood/covariance and forbid synthetic joint or independent-experiment treatment; mutation injection is rejected.
The S3 table, photon sector, Sun-centered frame, dimensions and source locators are checked before any row can pass.
The theory map is NOT_ADMITTED, the inverse contract has zero microscopic maps and candidate selection mutation is rejected.
Only a versioned interface manifest, scripts, run artifacts and append-only records were added; T-054/T-059 methods and owner order were not edited.

boundary: R-446 is a T0 source-interface audit. It does not evaluate a microscopic candidate, prove Lorentz invariance or a causal cone, identify dynamics or a physical vacuum, close Pre-A/Sector-A/C6, establish QFT/Yang-Mills/gravity, or prove continuum, empirical predictivity or a mass gap.
next_action: Keep the seven-row interface frozen. Seek source-owned uncertainty/covariance and a complete four-stage candidate map; if those inputs do not arrive, park this anchor without scoring and continue the unchanged forward owner intake.
stop_or_redesign: If the source edition or row identity changes, issue a new packet version rather than editing this record.
If a future row lacks a source likelihood/covariance, retain feasibility-only status and exclude it from scoring.
If no candidate-owned four-stage map or production dynamics is supplied, report the inverse equivalence class and do not select a microscopic model.
no_overclaim: A hash-checked row interface is not a joint observation, a candidate fit, a physical Lorentz theorem, a Pre-A derivation or a Yang-Mills mass-gap proof.
